status: Static API boundary established; component implementation and actual regression remain pending

checked.finding: Read-only callbacks run after active, inactive, nonblocking-assignment and read-write queues drain. The current time slot is then deleted. Creating same-slot read-write work in a read-only callback produces a scheduler error.

Read-only/read-write synchronization callbacks use relative delay; cbAfterDelay schedules an active callback. The callback records actual simulator time. Future active work can be scheduled from a completed current time slot.
Zero-delay writes and direct/force/release writes are rejected during read-only synchronization. A positive delayed write copies supplied vector data and schedules a future active event.
The reviewed header exposes current simulation time and read-only-state query. It does not expose a next-event-time query. No earliest-event guarantee is inferred.

recommended_component_contract: Sample settled values and emit a bounded receipt from a read-only callback. Blocking for the next command here cannot stop an unfinished current active/NBA calculation.

Apply a simultaneous input batch only at an explicitly requested future simulator time via cbAfterDelay or another verified future active callback. Then request a same-time read-only observation so resulting delta work drains first.

Reject equal or past timestamps after a settled receipt. Do not silently add1ps or pretend public VPI can reopen the finished slot. Handle startup input initialization separately before the first settled receipt.
Capture four-state values with explicit masks. Keep raw same-time value-change observations distinct from the settled level used at a barrier.
Rust owns bounded framing, command IDs, monotonic time, external deadlines, EOF/cancel and run-owned process cleanup. It must not wait indefinitely for a callback blocked on input.

Do not advertise next-event lookahead or CPU synchronization until a conservative scheduler contract is established. No optimistic HDL run-ahead across an earlier possible CPU MMIO or IRQ is justified by these APIs.
required_actual_regressions: A tiny explicit fixture with sequential NBA and combinational delta updates must be fully settled at the receipt without any invented time increment.
Future input batches, simultaneous updates, same/past-time rejection, X/Z masks, truncated input, EOF and cancellation must retain exact times and terminate within declared bounds.
The selected S9 logic path must consume fresh external commands and return its actual responses. A fixture pass alone is not selected-logic acceptance.
